classification: post-outcome mechanism test; numeric vertical outcome unopened at specification freeze

response.dem: inherit completed original terrain geometry pinned Mapzen/AWS Skadi HGT tiles and bilinear interpolation

conditioning.wind_source: ERA5 hourly 10-m u/v via Earthmover Icechunk
conditioning.target_environment_support: target wind within focal individual's other-session q05-q95 and within q05-q95 of at least 2 other individuals in cohort

models.A: other-individual population stratum means plus common within-stratum wind slope
models.C: same-individual other-session stratum mean plus individual pooled within-stratum continuous wind slope

weighting: target events -> session mean loss; sessions equal within individual; individuals equal within panel

structural_gate.slope_denominator_rule: strictly > 1e-12 in self-history after 500-m-place x kinematic-state wind demeaning

permutation.unit: whole retained session labels within cohort

synthesis.reaction_norm_2_or_3: repeatable individual wind responses contribute across multiple systems
synthesis.reaction_norm_0_and_stable_self_2plus: current evidence favors stable self-history over this measurable wind reaction norm
